Container.Name: Stackyard
Container.Overview: A self-hosted homelab dashboard you actually want to look at.[br][br]Most dashboards are a wall of numbers and charts. Stackyard is the opposite: a calm, launcher-style grid of app tiles, folders, and a small number of genuinely useful widgets. Built to be glanced at a hundred times a day without feeling cluttered.[br][br]Everything is set up from the browser. Add app tiles, group them into folders, arrange pages, and drop in widgets for the services you already run. Widgets cover Docker, system health, downloads, media, backups, network and more.[br][br]Runs as one container with no external database and no runtime dependencies. Configuration and uploaded icons persist in the two paths below.[br][br]Note: most homelab services live on private addresses. The Allow Private IPs setting below is on by default so links and widgets pointing at your other containers work. Turn it off to keep the SSRF guard enabled.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: homelab dashboard homepage self-hosted launcher start page widgets
Container.DonateText: If Stackyard is useful to you, you can buy me a coffee.
Container.Changes:
### 1.24.0 - 2026-11-22
### Added
- Glass switches, sliders and segmented controls in the admin, and a glass tab bar on phones.
- The Weather widget credits its data provider in Settings and in its tooltip.
- Log Content Security Policy and Trusted Types violations to the container log.
- Warn at startup about a widget page with inline script, which a later release blocks.
- Add a Show password button to the sign-in box.
### Changed
- Pick a local System Summary temperature by sensor name, starting on the CPU.
- Drop the unneeded temperature mount from the example `docker-compose.yml`.
- Test on Safari 26.2 or newer on macOS and iOS.
- Bend the open folder's glass more and frost it less.
- Show a check or a cross on the Save button after a save.
- Open drop-downs out of their button, and pick an option by sliding a finger over the list.
- Show "Sign out all" and the dashboard Delete confirm as destructive actions.
- Redraw Now Playing as a turning VHS take-up reel whose tape grows with progress.
- Log how long a failed widget request took and the HTTP status the service returned.
- Log a warning, and name the keys in the save reply, when a save drops settings this release does not know.
- Drop unknown keys inside the server settings on save, as unknown top-level settings already were.
- Test the API on Node.js 26 when it runs outside Docker.
- Open the Link URL when you tap the Weather, Now Playing or Downloads widget on a phone.
- Wait at least 3 seconds between widget polls, whatever interval a widget asks for.
- Settings can be installed to the home screen as the same app as the dashboard.
- The Settings shortcut of an installed app has its own icon.
- Reload custom widgets less often while their page is out of view.
- Start dashboard polling only when the tab is visible.
- Skip downloading the whole config on every dashboard check when nothing changed.
- Make Settings text follow the browser's text size setting.
- Draw native checkboxes and radio buttons in the accent colour.
- Load each widget page's script from a file next to the page.
- Serve only image types from the icons folder.
- Glass edges bend the wallpaper like the glass in iOS and stay sharp on high-density screens.
- Tab bar icons and labels bend smoothly under the moving lens on phones.
- Keep Set available on the first-run prompt, and move focus to the first field to fix.
- Show visible labels on the first-run prompt's fields.
- Let password managers save the password set in Settings.
- Name the open Settings section in the page title.
- Show the badge popover without motion when keyboard focus opens it.
### Removed
- Remove the `WIDGETS_PATH` setting from the Compose example. Mount a custom widget into the built-in widgets folder instead.
### Fixed
- With Reduce Transparency on, a held colour slider knob is solid instead of see-through.
- Keep a System Summary temperature on the same sensor after a reboot.
- Show the whole Unraid array in a System Summary disk slot that is blank or set to /.
- Show "Not set up yet", not "Out of reach", when a Backup slot, an Up Next source or a Connections service has an address that is not valid.
- Reach a Kopia backup server whose address has no http:// or https://.
- Report a service reply too large to read as a service error, not "Something went wrong".
- Keep a new secret typed into a widget's settings when the Size or View changes before Save.
- Keep each source's stored key with the right source after one is removed and the Size or View changes.
- Save a Settings change made while another save is still running, instead of refusing it as changed elsewhere.
- Show a new wallpaper behind Settings as soon as it is saved, not on the next visit.
- Show the icons and the show-password button on the setup screen for a refused address or a damaged password.
- Show a widget saved without a size at the same size on the dashboard as its frame loads, instead of a smaller frame in a larger tile.
- Open the link for the selected Disk Health provider when the widget is tapped on a phone.
- Remove the light diamond in the open folder's glass.
- Now Playing no longer reads its error twice to screen readers.
- Now Playing tells screen readers how long ago its server stopped answering.
- Now Playing pauses its reel in a background tab.
- Now Playing's time since a failure meets 4.5:1 contrast.
- GitHub contributions, System Summary and Backup tell screen readers how long ago their service stopped answering.
- A finger held on a switch, slider or segmented control in Settings no longer scrolls the page.
- A swipe that starts on a switch or segmented control and ends off it no longer changes the setting.
- Apply the log level set in Settings to the first lines logged at startup.
- Raise destructive button text to WCAG AA contrast in light and dark mode.
- The Docker image and the demo site include the Stackyard licence and notice.
- Show custom widgets that embed a page from another address.
- The AdGuard Home DNS widget's screen-reader summary no longer reports a cached count of 0.
- Size-specific Apple touch icon requests, such as `/apple-touch-icon-180x180.png`, return the dashboard icon instead of 404.
- The admin page shows the dashboard icon in browser tabs and Home Screen bookmarks.
- Keep the side margin in an open folder on desktop when app titles are off.
- Stop the arrow keys from turning the page while you type in a field, hold a modifier key, or have a dialog open.
- Keep keyboard focus on the visible page after a page turn.
- Stop a second tap on a badge from closing and reopening its popover.
- Make the badge popover usable inside an open folder.
- Let screen readers read every badge value without opening the popover.
- Return focus to the button that opened a prompt after the prompt finishes.
- Keep Search open when Escape cancels text being composed.
- Announce the search result count once typing pauses.
- Keep the Unsplash link in the photo credit fully visible.
- Tell screen readers that the Search pill and folder tiles open a dialog.
- Keep the first-run password prompt open when Escape is pressed twice.
- Read the password strength hint only when its level changes.
- Say a password mismatch on the first-run prompt only after the confirmation field is left.
- Announce a repeated sign-in or setup error again.
- Announce required fields as required, and stop reading the required star as "star".
- Mark the app name, app address, folder name and custom widget URL as required.
- Read each field's hint together with the field in Settings.
- Show an error for a poll interval outside 10 to 3600 seconds instead of silently changing it.
- Announce the type and size choosers as radio groups.
- Announce "Working" on slow row actions.
### Security
- Refuse an unsafe link in the Disk Health TrueNAS and Unraid, DNS, GitHub and Backup link fields on save, as the Scrutiny link already was.
- Update nginx to 1.30.7.
- Refuse a `javascript:` or other unsafe link in the Link URL of Books, Connections, Downloads, Now Playing, System Summary, Up Next and Weather.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the dashboard is reached on.

Config.Name: Config Storage
Config.Description: Dashboard configuration. Keep this, or every setting is lost on update.

Config.Name: Icon Storage
Config.Description: Icons you upload for your app tiles.

Config.Name: Allow Private IPs
Config.Description: Let the editor test apps, badges and widgets on private addresses, and load a wallpaper link from one. Saved apps, badges and widgets reach private addresses either way. Set to false to keep the SSRF guard on.

Config.Name: Docker Socket Proxy URL
Config.Description: Optional. Address of a Docker socket proxy, for the Docker widgets. Example: http://socket-proxy:2375

Config.Name: Trust Proxy
Config.Description: Optional. Set to true behind a reverse proxy that terminates HTTPS, so the sign-in cookie is marked HTTPS-only.

Config.Name: Node Options
Config.Description: Node heap cap. Keep it near half the --memory limit in Extra Parameters, and raise both together.
